object_description: three distinct volumes forming a solids-and-voids composition
design_condition: The three volumes follow the site geometry, integrate the existing building, and define a sequence of outdoor spaces including a forecourt, college square, green space, and sports areas.

positive.statement: The implementation concept successfully integrates existing buildings and developments.

position.rationale: Three separated volumes visibly organize the site, with approximate integration read from the distributed plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The college square provides a well-defined reference space for the new college.

position.rationale: The open central area between the southern volumes reads as the principal shared square.

positive.statement: The distribution into three volumes allows great flexibility of use.

position.rationale: Top and elevation views clearly show three spatially separated masses with intervening voids.

positive.statement: The refectory and aula building and the gymnasium rooms are organized in a clear and functional manner.

position.target: refectory and aula building and gymnasium rooms
position.rationale: The southern-right and southern-left volumes provide approximate anchors for the grouped communal and sports functions.

negative.statement: The duplicated pedestrian traffic considerably weakens the concept of the project implementation.

position.rationale: The central gap between volumes is the most plausible shared circulation zone.

negative.statement: The typology and organization of the main classroom building are not convincing, particularly because orientation is difficult on the ground floor.

position.rationale: The northern volume is clearly identifiable in plan and its ground-level organization is only partially exposed.

negative.statement: The central courtyard should have been more generous and perhaps extended over the entire height of the building.

position.rationale: A distinct internal rectangular void is clearly visible within the northern volume.

negative.statement: Some spaces around the central courtyard are in second daylight and lack natural light and ventilation.

position.rationale: Adjacent perimeter space is approximated on the northern volume surface; daylight conditions are not directly represented.

negative.statement: The circulation around the courtyard leaves little possibility of informal appropriation for users.

position.rationale: A perimeter anchor around the visible courtyard approximates the circulation zone.
